factset_insight_rss.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain the RSS item publication timestamp separately from repository retrieval time; do not infer missing publication timestamps.
factset_insight_rss.revision_pinning_rule: Materialize only normalized RSS metadata as content-addressed JSON and pin accepted snapshots by SHA-256; article bodies are not stored in public Git history.
factset_insight_rss.retry_policy: Fail closed on network, malformed XML, empty feeds, duplicate identities, or missing required title/link/publication fields; never replace a valid snapshot with an empty or partial synthetic feed.
factset_insight_rss.rate_limit_policy: Fetch the publisher RSS at the scheduled daily cadence and do not refetch unchanged accepted content solely to create another snapshot row.
factset_insight_rss.public_repository_policy: Public Git history may contain RSS metadata, titles, authors, publication timestamps, article URLs, hashes, and derived summaries. Do not store or republish full FactSet article bodies.
